name: Autopsy of a Dead Project
tagline: Paste a GitHub repo. An open-weight AI performs a forensic autopsy and reads the coroner's report. You leave with a death certificate.
signatureElement: the flatline — a per-mode pulse trace that runs, decays, flattens, and gets a seal stamp

signatureObject.name: the flatline (last heartbeat)
signatureObject.thesis: a repository has vital signs; when it dies they flatline — the whole app is a vital-signs monitor at a morgue bench, so the signature PERFORMS the verb 'classify how it died' instead of charting it

perSurface.landing: hero flatline breathing live above the single repo input (coroner's bench, skeptical→trusting)
perSurface.console: certificate flatline that flattens per death-mode and gets a wax seal stamp — the document identity, distinct from the live landing pulse

invariantPhrase: Every verdict carries an honest engine badge.
